name: Is marble a practical choice for bathroom floors and shower walls?

mainEntity.name: Is marble a practical choice for bathroom floors and shower walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural marble works well in bathrooms for vanity tops, floors, and shower walls, but it requires diligent sealing and care. Because marble is porous and contains calcium carbonate, it is vulnerable to acidic bathroom cleaners, dyes, and hard water stains. Honed marble provides a matte finish that conceals water marks and scratches better than polished marble, making it a safer, less slippery choice for floors. However, you must accept ongoing maintenance, including routine resealing and using only pH-neutral stone cleaners.
acceptedAnswer.description: Marble works well in bathrooms if properly sealed. Honed finishes are best for floors to reduce slip hazards and hide etching, though all marble requires pH-neutral cleaners and routine sealing.
